aboutPage.title: About Drive KKTC
aboutPage.content: Drive KKTC is an independent, premium tourism initiative designed to help travelers discover the natural beauty, history, and culinary secrets of Northern Cyprus. Encouraging slow travel and self-driven road trips, our routes guide you off the beaten path, from the medieval castle peaks of Girne to the wild, golden shores of Karpaz.
aboutPage.rule1: Keep Left: In Cyprus, traffic drives on the left side of the road, similar to the United Kingdom.
aboutPage.rule2: Seatbelts & Phones: Seatbelts are mandatory for all passengers. Using a mobile phone while driving is strictly illegal.
aboutPage.rule3: Signposts: Major destination names are in Turkish, with distance markers in kilometers.
aboutPage.rule4: Border Crossing: Rental cars rented in the South cannot be taken to the North without buying separate third-party insurance at the border crossing.
